title: Consolidation: The Coffeehouse Republic: Nyugat & Print Culture

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can discuss the history of Budapest's literary coffeehouses and the review Nyugat (1908–1941) with B2 lexical precision.
I can deploy contrastive topic frames (ami X-et illeti, ezzel szemben, míg ... addig, korántsem ... hanem) fluently.
I can apply preverb-verb inversion accurately whenever a constituent occupies the pre-verbal focus slot.
